posts.title: Pharmacy First for Acute Sore Throat (including suspected streptococcal infection)
posts.body: Pharmacy Delivered 4U can assess acute sore throat (including suspected streptococcal infection) through Pharmacy First where NHS criteria are met. Call 0300 303 3380 in Rotherham.

posts.title: Walk in or book ahead

posts.title: Private pharmacist consultation
posts.body: Pharmacy First consultations take place in a confidential setting with the pharmacy team at Pharmacy Delivered 4U, Rotherham. Call 0300 303 3380 (Rotherham).
